output.one_liner: Twenty is an open-source CRM platform providing REST and GraphQL APIs for managing CRM records with AI agent capabilities.

auth.notes: API key (static bearer token) created in Settings → Developers → API. OAuth supports both authorization code flow with PKCE and client credentials for server-to-server access.

evidence.snippet: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY. Create an API key in Settings → Developers → API → + Create key.
Twenty implements OAuth 2.0 with authorization code + PKCE for user-facing apps and client credentials for server-to-server access.

access.notes: Cloud trial available without credit card (7 days) or with card (30 days) with full API access included. Open-source core is free to self-host. Cloud plans require payment after trial.

evidence.snippet: Pick 30 days (with card) or 7 days (without card). Both include full access — unlimited contacts, email integration, custom objects, API.
Self-hosting the open source core is free.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 100 requests per minute; batch size 60 records per call

evidence.snippet: REST and GraphQL APIs generated from your workspace schema. Schema-per-tenant APIs.
Rate limits: Requests 100 per minute, Batch size 60 records per call
REST & GraphQL API: Yes. Webhooks: Yes.
Twenty exposes an MCP server so that AI assistants — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, and others — can read and write your CRM data.
Every Cloud workspace ships with a native MCP server. Connect your AI assistant via OAuth.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free credentials via cloud trial or open-source self-hosting; documented REST and GraphQL APIs; Composio toolkit with 23 tools already exists.

overview_evidence.snippet: Twenty | #1 Open Source CRM. Build your Enterprise CRM at AI Speed.
Twenty is a production-ready CRM you can reshape as you go. Built for Agents.
